author: Thermetrics
versionDescription: Parts Picking > Trips / IHS: (1) years now run oldest first (2026, 2027, 2028), Unknown last. (2) New 'Pick List (PDF)' button inside each expanded trip downloads a printable pick list (part number, bin, description, qty, tick box) sorted by bin location, to put in the client's box. (3) The Trips / IHS sub-tab now shows a badge, and a notice inside, with the number of trips in Pre-Travel Activities, like the Online Orders badge.
